why_best: It injects a high-impact, surreal kinetic charge that keeps audience attention locked during high-tempo promotional cuts.
why_bad: Relying on a standard hard edit or soft dissolve would feel flat and fail to match the aggressive, forward-leaning tone of this campaign.
trap: A near-miss would over-extend the visual artifacts past the visual pivot, muddying the incoming scene instead of cleanly delivering the eye to the new focal point.
